name: Barbell Bench Press
explanation: Lie on a flat bench, grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width. Lower the bar to your chest, then press up to full arm extension.

name: Barbell Squat
explanation: Place the barbell on your upper back. Bend at hips and knees to lower until thighs are parallel to the floor, then drive back up.

name: Deadlift
explanation: Stand with feet hip-width apart, grip the bar outside your knees. Drive through your feet, extending hips and knees simultaneously.

name: Overhead Press
explanation: Standing with barbell at shoulder height, press the bar overhead to full lockout, then lower back to shoulders.

name: Barbell Row
explanation: Hinge at the hips with a slight knee bend. Pull the barbell from hanging position to your lower chest/upper abdomen.

name: Pull-up
explanation: Hang from a bar with overhand grip. Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar, then lower with control.

name: Plank
explanation: Hold a push-up position on your forearms, keeping your body in a straight line from head to heels.

name: Dumbbell Lunges
explanation: Hold dumbbells at your sides. Step forward, lowering your back knee toward the floor, then push back to standing.
